question.text: For a research analyst, understanding Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) and Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) flows is important because:

answer.text: RAs are required to directly manage FDI inflows into the country
FDI / FPI flows are focus areas for understanding the economy and economic environment when evaluating economies
SEBI mandates that all research reports must contain FDI/FPI analysis
FDI and FPI are the only sources of corporate funding in India

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Research Analyst workbook (p.17), FDI and FPI flows are listed as focus areas under understanding the economy / economic environment when evaluating economies. Tracking them helps the analyst assess the investment climate. The Trap: Option A confuses the RA's role with that of policymakers. Option C is not a regulatory mandate. Option D is incorrect because companies have many funding sources beyond FDI / FPI. Note: Keep the answer narrowly tied to "understanding the economy / economic environment"; broader currency-impact and market-sentiment claims need a separate citation.
